sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to all Medicare Advantage products and for network provider services reported using the UB04 and CMS 1500 form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form.

children.title: Overview
children.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for homocysteine testing associated with metabolism-related conditions.

children.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
children.content: NOTE: Procedure codes appearing in policy documents are included only as a general reference tool for each policy. They may not be all-inclusive. UnitedHealthcare will consider reimbursement of the following homocysteine testing procedure code for individuals with any of the conditions listed below: Procedure Code(s) 83090 Condition(s) a. Homocystinuria b. Vitamin B12 deficiency c. Chronic ischemic heart disease UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the homocysteine testing procedure codes above for any other conditions.
